description: Adds one of the user’s own files to a project, to use in scripts as "midia/<nome>". Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 15 MB (best at the video’s size: 1920×1080 for 16:9, 1080×1920 for 9:16). Clips and the user’s own recordings (presenter "video"): MP4 or WebM up to 80 MB (720p is plenty; phone video works). With `url` (a public https link straight to the file) it is fetched now. Without it, returns a single-use upload link valid ~15 min in two forms: a page on avatar.diatech.solutions where the user drags the file in the browser (show that page to users of ChatGPT, claude.ai or any chat without a shell), and a PUT URL for agents with a shell (curl -X PUT --data-binary @file '<url>'). Same name again replaces the file. Only send what the user owns or may use. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

url.description: Public https link straight to the file (optional; without it you get an upload URL).
